lanes.activity: Is the actor active now? Run watch.sh first. Give the last-seen time per indicator on every source and one verdict: ACTIVE, DORMANT or UNCLEAR.
lanes.edge: What did the indicators send through the edge? First seen, hosts, paths, status, user agent, TLS fingerprint, blocks, on all edge logs.
lanes.api: Which endpoints did the actor reach? Authentication failures, id enumeration, error spikes, and the handler code of each endpoint that answered.
lanes.identity: Which accounts did the actor make or use? Sign-ups, logins, sessions, API keys and tokens, MFA changes, admin actions.
lanes.db: What does the database show as ground truth for the actor's objects and changes? Name each database you cannot read.
lanes.history: When did this activity start? Search the full retention of each source for the fingerprint, ASN and path signature before you answer.
lanes.control: Which defence acted on the request path (WAF, rate limit, challenge, autoscaling)? When, on which requests, and why not sooner? Compare the live config with the code.
lanes.impact: What failed, for which tenants and flows, from when to when? Give the money side effects (failed callbacks, lost transactions).
lanes.changes: Which deploys, config and infra changes, scaling events and audit-log events happened in the hours before the start? One verdict per change: CAUSE or NOT CAUSE.
lanes.hunt-cloud: Cloud control plane: is there a sign of an attacker in the audit logs, IAM, network rules and public resources?
lanes.hunt-network: Network: is there a sign of an attacker in flow logs, open ports and egress?
lanes.hunt-platform: Platform: is there a sign of an attacker in the clusters, workloads, secrets and the deploy system?
lanes.hunt-code: Code and CI: is there a sign of an attacker in the repositories, pipelines, tokens and packages?
lanes.hunt-data: Data stores: is there a sign of an attacker in database access, exports and public storage?
lanes.hunt-edge: Edge: is there a sign of an attacker in CDN, WAF and load balancer logs (scans with 2xx, floods, new tooling)?
lanes.hunt-api: APIs: is there a sign of an attacker in enumeration, authentication failures and private endpoints that answer?
lanes.hunt-identity: Identity: is there a sign of an attacker in sign-ups, logins, sessions, resets and MFA changes?
lanes.hunt-admin: Admin tools: is there a sign of an attacker in back-office use, operator accounts, roles and money actions?
